اشتملن (form VIII)
# اِشْتَمَلْنَ (ištamalna) /iʃ.ta.mal.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِشْتَمَلَ (ištamala)
# اُشْتُمِلْنَ (uštumilna) /uʃ.tu.mil.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِشْتَمَلَ (ištamala)
# اِشْتَمِلْنَ (ištamilna) /iʃ.ta.mil.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِشْتَمَلَ (ištamala)
